_about: The pronouns (Zamjenice): personal, demonstrative and relative pronouns and إِيَّا, built by the particle engine (the same shape and gate) — docs/PARTICLES-PLAN.md. Read from the corpus by fil.corpus.pronouns; `fil pronouns check` holds counts and ayat to the corpus. Ayah quotations: double quotation marks quote an ayah (en “…”, bs „…“) and name it (the item's `ref`, or s:a in the text); glosses take single ones (‘…’, ‚…‘). English quotes only the shipped Pickthall text, word for word; Bosnian quotes are our own translation from the Arabic, declared by `"ayahQuotes": {"bs": "own"}` — never Sahih International's or Korkut's wording (fil.ayah_quotes, run by the tests and `check`).

grammar.bs: Odnosna zamjenica, muški rod množine (i za mješovitu skupinu): ‚oni koji‘. U Kur'anu ima isti oblik u svakom padežu. Najčešća je odnosna riječ Kur'ana: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ – ‚oni koji vjeruju‘.
grammar.en: The relative pronoun, masculine plural (also for a mixed group): ‘those who’. In the Quran it has the same form in every case. It is the Quran's most frequent relative word: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ – ‘those who believe’.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: REL (1080) — the corpus's الَّذِي (MP).
Blind Sonnet review (batch 3): every flag applied — quoted renderings, tenses, overstatements (only/always/every) softened; no attribution changed (the reviewer checked none).

explanation.bs: Isti oblik bez obzira da li opisuje imenicu, dolazi iza imenice u genitivnom odnosu (put onih koji…) ili iza إِلَّا.
explanation.en: The same form whether it describes a noun, follows a noun in annexation (the path of those who…), or comes after إِلَّا.

why.bs: „koji vjeruju u nevidljivo…“ – ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ.
why.en: “Who believe in the Unseen…” – ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ.

why.bs: „put onih kojima si blagodat dao…“ – ـهِمْ u عَلَيْهِمْ se vraća na ٱلَّذِينَ.
why.en: “The path of those whom Thou hast favoured…” – ـهِمْ in عَلَيْهِمْ returns to ٱلَّذِينَ.

why.bs: „osim onih koji vjeruju i čine dobra djela…“ – iza إِلَّا, isti oblik.
why.en: “Save those who believe and do good works…” – after إِلَّا, the same form.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica trećeg lica muškog roda jednine, samostalna riječ (ne nastavak). Upućuje na nekoga ili nešto muškog roda, i na Allaha. Stoji kao subjekat, a između subjekta i predikata kao zamjenica razdvajanja.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the third person, masculine singular, a word of its own (not a suffix). It points to someone or something masculine, and to Allah. It stands as a subject, and between a subject and its predicate as the pronoun of separation.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: PRON (481) — the independent هُوَ (3MS), with وَ/فَ/لَـ before it; a pronoun after a preposition (لَهُ، بِهِ) and every suffix are not counted. The two uses share the tag.

Separation pronoun: Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section شرح حال الضمير المسمى فصلا وعمادا (chapter 4): the conditions (what precedes is a mubtadaʾ now or originally, examples 2:5, 37:165, 5:117, 18:39); its benefits: that what follows is a predicate, not a follower (hence 'faṣl' and 'ʿimād'), emphasis, and restriction; az-Zamaḫšarī names all three on 2:5 — CONFIRMED.
Blind Sonnet review (batch 3): every flag applied — quoted renderings, tenses, overstatements (only/always/every) softened; no attribution changed (the reviewer checked none).

explanation.bs: Kao subjekat imeničke rečenice, ili ispred glagola kad se naglašava ko radnju čini.
explanation.en: As the subject of a nominal sentence, or before a verb when who does the deed is stressed.

why.bs: „I On je Onaj Koji prašta, Koji voli“ – هُوَ je subjekat, a ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ predikat.
why.en: “And He is the Forgiving, the Loving” – هُوَ is the subject, ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ the predicate.

why.bs: „A kad se razbolim, On me liječi“ – فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ: Ibrahim ističe da On, a ne drugi, liječi.
why.en: “And when I sicken, then He healeth me” – فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ: Abraham stresses that it is He, not another, who cures.

explanation.bs: Između subjekta i određenog predikata zamjenica kazuje da je ono iza nje predikat, a ne pridjev ili dodatak – zato se zove ‚razdvajanje‘ (faṣl), a i ‚oslonac‘ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām navodi još dvije koristi, naglašavanje i ograničavanje, a az-Zamaḫšarī za 2:5 kaže sve troje – ‚oni, i samo oni‘ (o هُمْ u 2:5).
explanation.en: Between a subject and a definite predicate the pronoun says that what follows is the predicate, not an adjective or a follower – hence its name ‘separation’ (faṣl), and also ‘support’ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām names two more benefits, emphasis and restriction, and az-Zamaḫšarī says all three on 2:5 – ‘they, and they alone’ (of هُمْ in 2:5).

why.bs: „Uistinu, On je Onaj Koji čuje i zna“ – إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ: هُوَ razdvaja subjekat (nastavak uz إِنَّ) od predikata.
why.en: “Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower” – إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ: هُوَ separates the subject (the pronoun on إِنَّ) from the predicate.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za daljinu, muški rod jednine: ذَا + lām udaljenosti + كَ obraćanja. Ibn Hišām kaže da je to كَ čestica obraćanja bez mjesta u rečenici; zato se mijenja prema onome kome se govori (ذَٰلِكُمْ ‚to, vama‘). S كَـ poređenja daje كَذَٰلِكَ – ‚tako‘. Ženski rod je تِلْكَ, množina أُولَٰئِكَ.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the far, masculine singular: ذَا + the lām of distance + the كَ of address. Ibn Hišām says this كَ is a particle of address with no place in the sentence; so it changes with who is addressed (ذَٰلِكُمْ ‘that, to you all’). With the كَـ of likeness it gives كَذَٰلِكَ – ‘thus’. The feminine is تِلْكَ, the plural أُولَٰئِكَ.

sources: Ibn Hišām al-Anṣārī, Muġnī al-labīb ʿan kutub al-aʿārīb
Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com): the tag of each use
notes: Counted: DEM (479) — the corpus's ذا (MS) with the كَ of address in the same word: ذَٰلِكَ، ذَٰلِكُمْ، كَذَٰلِكَ … (122 of them with the كَـ of likeness).

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section حرف الكاف, the kāf that does not govern: 'a particle of meaning with no place, its meaning address, attached to the demonstrative like ذلك وتلك' — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Upućuje na ono što je spomenuto ili prisutno; prevodioci ga ponekad prevode s ‚ovo‘ (2:2).
explanation.en: It points to something mentioned or present; translators sometimes render it ‘this’ (2:2).

why.bs: „Ta Knjiga – u nju nema sumnje…“ – ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ; i Korkut i Sahih International ovdje kažu ‚ova / this‘.
why.en: “This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt…” – ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ; Pickthall, like Korkut and Sahih International, says ‘this’ here.

why.bs: „…to je dalek povratak!“ – ذَٰلِكَ upućuje na oživljenje o kojem govore.
why.en: “…That would be a far return!” – ذَٰلِكَ points to the raising they speak of.

why.bs: „Tako Mi nagrađujemo one koji čine dobro“ – كَذَٰلِكَ: ‚tako‘.
why.en: “Thus do We reward the good” – كَذَٰلِكَ: ‘thus’.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica trećeg lica muškog roda množine (i za mješovitu skupinu). Ispred hemzet al-wasla se izgovara هُمُ (هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ).
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the third person, masculine plural (also for a mixed group). Before a connecting hamza it is said هُمُ (هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ).

explanation.bs: Često u opisu neke skupine, ispred glagola ili predikata.
explanation.en: Often in describing a group, before a verb or a predicate.

why.bs: „i u praskozorje su oprost tražili“ – وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ.
why.en: “And ere the dawning of each day [they] would seek forgiveness” – وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ.

why.bs: „voće, i oni će biti počašćeni“ – وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ: subjekat i predikat.
why.en: “Fruits. And they will be honoured” – وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ: subject and predicate.

explanation.bs: Između subjekta i određenog predikata zamjenica kazuje da je ono iza nje predikat, a ne pridjev ili dodatak – zato se zove ‚razdvajanje‘ (faṣl), a i ‚oslonac‘ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām navodi još dvije koristi, naglašavanje i ograničavanje, a az-Zamaḫšarī za 2:5 kaže sve troje – ‚oni, i samo oni‘ (o هُمْ u 2:5).
explanation.en: Between a subject and a definite predicate the pronoun says that what follows is the predicate, not an adjective or a follower – hence its name ‘separation’ (faṣl), and also ‘support’ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām names two more benefits, emphasis and restriction, and az-Zamaḫšarī says all three on 2:5 – ‘they, and they alone’ (of هُمْ in 2:5).

why.bs: „Oni su na uputi od svoga Gospodara, i upravo su oni uspješni“ – وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ.
why.en: “These depend on guidance from their Lord. These [– they, and they alone –] are the successful” – وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ.

why.bs: „Upravo su oni nasljednici“ – أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ.
why.en: “These are [they who are] the heirs” – أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ.

grammar.bs: Odnosna zamjenica, muški rod jednine: ‚koji, onaj koji‘. Iza nje dolazi rečenica (ṣila) u kojoj je zamjenica što se na nju vraća – izgovorena ili podrazumijevana. Kao pridjev slijedi određenu imenicu (رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ), a može stajati i sama: ‚Onaj koji…‘. Ženski rod je الَّتِي, množina الَّذِينَ.
grammar.en: The relative pronoun, masculine singular: ‘who, which, the one who’. A sentence follows it (the ṣila) holding a pronoun that returns to it – spoken or understood. As an adjective it follows a definite noun (رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ), and it can stand alone: ‘the One who…’. The feminine is الَّتِي, the plural الَّذِينَ.

explanation.bs: U Kur'anu često opisuje Allaha Njegovim djelima: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ – ‚Onaj koji je stvorio‘.
explanation.en: In the Quran it often describes Allah by His deeds: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ – ‘the One who created’.

why.bs: „O ljudi, obožavajte svoga Gospodara, Koji je stvorio vas…“ – ٱلَّذِى kao pridjev od رَبَّكُمُ.
why.en: “O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you…” – ٱلَّذِى as an adjective of رَبَّكُمُ.

why.bs: „Koji je stvorio pa uskladio“ – ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ.
why.en: “Who createth, then disposeth” – ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ.

why.bs: „Koji je perom poučio“ – ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ.
why.en: “Who teacheth by the pen” – ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za blizinu, muški rod jednine: هَا pažnje + ذَا. Kad iza nje dođe imenica s članom, to je obično ‚ovaj …‘ (هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ) i imenica ima padež njenog mjesta; kad dođe imenica bez člana, rečenica je ‚ovo je …‘ (هَٰذَا يَوْمُ). Ženski rod je هَٰذِهِ, množina هَٰؤُلَاءِ. Ibn Hišām: هَا pažnje stavlja se ispred pokazne riječi koja nije za daljinu.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the near, masculine singular: the هَا of attention + ذَا. When a noun with the article follows, it is usually ‘this …’ (هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ) and the noun has the case of its place; when a noun without the article follows, the sentence is ‘this is …’ (هَٰذَا يَوْمُ). The feminine is هَٰذِهِ, the plural هَٰؤُلَاءِ. Ibn Hišām: the هَا of attention is put before a demonstrative that is not for the far.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section ها (third aspect): it enters 'الإشارة غير المختصة بالبعيد نحو هذا' — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Obično imenica s članom iza nje opisuje ono na što se pokazuje (‚ovaj grad‘), a imenica bez člana je predikat (‚ovo je dan‘); ali i određena imenica, često s odnosnom rečenicom, može biti predikat („Ovo je Vatra koju…“, 52:14). Sama pokazna zamjenica se ne mijenja: ima samo mjesto padeža.
explanation.en: Usually a noun with the article after it names what is pointed at (‘this city’), and a noun without it is the predicate (‘this is a day’); but a definite noun, often followed by a relative clause, can also be the predicate (“This is the Fire which…”, 52:14). The demonstrative itself does not change: it only stands in the place of a case.

why.bs: „i ovog sigurnog grada“ – وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ: imenica s članom je u genitivu, a هَٰذَا je na mjestu genitiva (zakletva).
why.en: “And by this land made safe” – وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ: the noun with the article is genitive, and هَٰذَا is in the place of the genitive (an oath).

why.bs: „Ovo je Dan u kojem neće govoriti“ – هَٰذَا يَوْمُ: bez člana, ‚ovo je‘.
why.en: “This is a day wherein they speak not” – هَٰذَا يَوْمُ: no article, ‘this is’.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za daljinu, množina za oba roda (أُولَاءِ + كَ obraćanja). U Kur'anu najčešće počinje rečenicu koja kaže kakvi su oni koji su upravo opisani: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى – ‚oni su na uputi‘.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the far, plural for both genders (أُولَاءِ + the كَ of address). In the Quran it mostly opens a sentence saying what those just described are: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى – ‘those are upon guidance’.

explanation.bs: Često uz zamjenicu razdvajanja: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ… – ‚upravo su oni…‘.
explanation.en: Often with the pronoun of separation: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ… – ‘it is those who…’.

why.bs: „Oni su na uputi od svoga Gospodara…“ – o onima opisanim u 2:3–4.
why.en: “These depend on guidance from their Lord…” – of those described in 2:3–4.

why.bs: „Oni su ti približeni“ – أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ.
why.en: “Those are they who will be brought nigh” – أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica drugog lica muškog roda množine (i za mješovitu skupinu). Često u rečenici stanja s وَ: وَأَنتُمْ – ‚a vi…, dok vi…‘.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the second person, masculine plural (also for a mixed group). Often in a clause of state with وَ: وَأَنتُمْ – ‘while you…’.

Verified against Muġnī (OpenITI 0761JamalDinIbnHisham.MughniLabib.JK001131-ara1), section ها (third aspect): it enters 'a nominative pronoun whose predicate is a demonstrative, like ها أنتم أولاء' — CONFIRMED.

explanation.bs: Zamjenica drugog lica množine, kao subjekat ili u rečenici stanja. Ibn Hišām navodi da se هَا pažnje stavlja i ispred zamjenice u nominativu čiji je predikat pokazna riječ: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ.
explanation.en: The pronoun of the second person plural, as a subject or in a clause of state. Ibn Hišām notes that the هَا of attention is also put before a pronoun in the nominative whose predicate is a demonstrative: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ.

why.bs: „dok se vi zabavljate?“ – وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ: rečenica stanja.
why.en: “While ye amuse yourselves?” – وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ: a clause of state.

why.bs: „Reče: Hoćete li vi pogledati?“ – هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ.
why.en: “He saith: Will ye look?” – هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ.

why.bs: „Eto, vi ste ti koji ih volite, a oni vas ne vole…“ – هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ: هَا pažnje ispred أَنتُمْ.
why.en: “Lo! ye are those who love them though they love you not…” – هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ: the هَا of attention before أَنتُمْ.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica prvog lica množine. U Kur'anu njome često govori Allah o Sebi – množina veličine, ne broja – a i ljudi o sebi.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the first person plural. In the Quran Allah often speaks of Himself with it – the plural of majesty, not of number – and people of themselves.

explanation.bs: Ispred glagola naglašava ko radnju čini; iza إِنَّا ponavlja i osnažuje ‚Mi‘.
explanation.en: Before a verb it stresses who does the deed; after إِنَّا it repeats and strengthens ‘We’.

why.bs: „Mi smo vas stvorili, pa zašto onda ne priznajete istinu?“ – نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ.
why.en: “We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?” – نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ.

why.bs: „Uistinu, Mi, upravo Mi objavljujemo Opomenu, i Mi ćemo je, zaista, čuvati“ – إِنَّا نَحْنُ: ‚Mi‘ dvaput.
why.en: “Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian” – إِنَّا نَحْنُ: ‘We’ twice.

explanation.bs: Između subjekta i određenog predikata zamjenica kazuje da je ono iza nje predikat, a ne pridjev ili dodatak – zato se zove ‚razdvajanje‘ (faṣl), a i ‚oslonac‘ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām navodi još dvije koristi, naglašavanje i ograničavanje, a az-Zamaḫšarī za 2:5 kaže sve troje – ‚oni, i samo oni‘ (o هُمْ u 2:5).
explanation.en: Between a subject and a definite predicate the pronoun says that what follows is the predicate, not an adjective or a follower – hence its name ‘separation’ (faṣl), and also ‘support’ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām names two more benefits, emphasis and restriction, and az-Zamaḫšarī says all three on 2:5 – ‘they, and they alone’ (of هُمْ in 2:5).

why.bs: „I mi smo, zaista, oni koji se u redove postrojavaju“ – وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ: Ibn Hišām navodi ovaj ajet; ovdje govore meleki.
why.en: “Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks” – وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ: Ibn Hišām cites this ayah; here the angels speak.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica drugog lica muškog roda jednine. U Kur'anu se njome Allah često obraća Poslaniku, poslanici i meleki njome se obraćaju Allahu u dovi i hvali, a koristi se i među ljudima.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the second person, masculine singular. In the Quran Allah often addresses the Prophet with it, prophets and angels address Allah with it in supplication and praise, and it is used between people as well.

explanation.bs: Kao subjekat imeničke rečenice; s إِنَّمَا ograničava: ‚ti si samo…‘.
explanation.en: As the subject of a nominal sentence; with إِنَّمَا it restricts: ‘you are only…’.

why.bs: „Zato opominji, ti si samo onaj koji opominje“ – إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ.
why.en: “Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer” – إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ.

explanation.bs: Između subjekta i određenog predikata zamjenica kazuje da je ono iza nje predikat, a ne pridjev ili dodatak – zato se zove ‚razdvajanje‘ (faṣl), a i ‚oslonac‘ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām navodi još dvije koristi, naglašavanje i ograničavanje, a az-Zamaḫšarī za 2:5 kaže sve troje – ‚oni, i samo oni‘ (o هُمْ u 2:5). Može stajati i iza كَانَ, kad je predikat u akuzativu.
explanation.en: Between a subject and a definite predicate the pronoun says that what follows is the predicate, not an adjective or a follower – hence its name ‘separation’ (faṣl), and also ‘support’ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām names two more benefits, emphasis and restriction, and az-Zamaḫšarī says all three on 2:5 – ‘they, and they alone’ (of هُمْ in 2:5). It can also stand after كَانَ, when the predicate is accusative.

why.bs: „…Uistinu, samo si Ti Onaj Koji sve zna, Mudri“ – إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ.
why.en: “…Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise” – إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ.

why.bs: „…a kad si me uzeo, Ti si bio Onaj Koji nad njima bdi…“ – prvo أَنتَ, u كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ: Ibn Hišām navodi ovaj ajet; ٱلرَّقِيبَ je predikat od كَانَ, u akuzativu.
why.en: “…and when Thou tookest me Thou wast the Watcher over them…” – the first أَنتَ, in كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ: Ibn Hišām cites this ayah; ٱلرَّقِيبَ is the predicate of كَانَ, accusative.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica prvog lica jednine, za muški i ženski rod. U Mushafu se piše s elifom na kraju (أَنَا۠), ali se u Ḥafṣovom čitanju elif izgovara samo kad se na riječi stane; u nastavku se kaže ‚ana‘ s kratkim a.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the first person singular, masculine and feminine alike. In the Mushaf it is written with a final alif (أَنَا۠), but in Ḥafṣ's reading the alif is said only when one stops on the word; in connected reading it is ‘ana’ with a short a.

explanation.bs: Često u govoru poslanika i u Allahovom govoru o Sebi, a i u govoru drugih.
explanation.en: Often in the speech of the prophets and in Allah's speech about Himself, and in the speech of others too.

why.bs: „niti sam ja obožavalac onoga što vi obožavate“ – وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ.
why.en: “And I shall not worship that which ye worship” – وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ.

explanation.bs: Između subjekta i određenog predikata zamjenica kazuje da je ono iza nje predikat, a ne pridjev ili dodatak – zato se zove ‚razdvajanje‘ (faṣl), a i ‚oslonac‘ (ʿimād). Može stajati i između dva objekta glagola mišljenja i viđenja (18:39).
explanation.en: Between a subject and a definite predicate the pronoun says that what follows is the predicate, not an adjective or a follower – hence its name ‘separation’ (faṣl), and also ‘support’ (ʿimād). Ibn Hišām names two more benefits, emphasis and restriction, and az-Zamaḫšarī says all three on 2:5 – ‘they, and they alone’ (of هُمْ in 2:5). It can also stand between the two objects of a verb of thinking or seeing (18:39).

why.bs: „Obavijesti Moje robove da sam Ja, uistinu, Onaj Koji prašta, Milostivi“ – أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ.
why.en: “Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful” – أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ.

why.bs: „…ako smatraš da sam ja siromašniji od tebe imetkom i djecom“ – تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ: Ibn Hišām navodi ovaj ajet; أَقَلَّ je drugi objekat glagola.
why.en: “…Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children” – تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ: Ibn Hišām cites this ayah; أَقَلَّ is the verb's second object.

grammar.bs: Odnosna zamjenica, ženski rod jednine. Kao الَّذِي, iza nje dolazi rečenica sa zamjenicom koja se na nju vraća; ta zamjenica se može izostaviti kad je objekat (نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ – ‚blagodat koju sam (je) dao‘).
grammar.en: The relative pronoun, feminine singular. As with الَّذِي, a sentence follows it with a pronoun returning to it; that pronoun may be left out when it is an object (نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ – ‘My favour which I bestowed’).

explanation.bs: Slaže se s imenicom ženskog roda na koju se odnosi.
explanation.en: It agrees with the feminine noun it refers to.

why.bs: „I klonite se Vatre koja je spremljena nevjernicima“ – ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُعِدَّتْ.
why.en: “And ward off (from yourselves) the Fire [which is] prepared for disbelievers” – ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُعِدَّتْ.

why.bs: „kojem ravnog nije stvoreno u zemljama“ – ٱلَّتِى se odnosi na إِرَمَ (89:7), a ـهَا u مِثْلُهَا se vraća na الَّتِي.
why.en: “The like of which was not created in the lands” – ٱلَّتِى refers to إِرَمَ (89:7), and ـهَا in مِثْلُهَا returns to الَّتِي.

why.bs: „…sjetite se Moje blagodati koju sam vam darovao…“ – ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ: zamjenica objekta je izostavljena.
why.en: “…Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you…” – ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ: the object pronoun is left out.

grammar.bs: Lična zamjenica trećeg lica ženskog roda jednine. Slaže se s gramatičkim rodom riječi na koju upućuje: zato se u Kur'anu odnosi i na Musaov štap (عَصًا), Džehennem ili noć Kadr – riječi ženskog roda, iako ih bosanski i engleski izriču drugačije.
grammar.en: The personal pronoun of the third person, feminine singular. It agrees with the grammatical gender of the word it points to: so in the Quran it also points to Moses' staff (عَصًا), Hellfire or the Night of Decree – feminine words, though Bosnian and English say them otherwise.

explanation.bs: Bosanski prijevod često kaže ‚on‘ ili ‚to‘, engleski ‚it‘, gdje arapski ima هِيَ.
explanation.en: The Bosnian translation often says ‘on’ or ‘to’, the English ‘it’, where the Arabic has هِيَ.

why.bs: „Pa ga baci, kad ono – zmija koja gmiže“ – هِيَ upućuje na štap (عَصًا, ženski rod), Korkut kaže ‚on‘.
why.en: “So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding” – هِيَ points to the staff (عَصًا, feminine).

why.bs: „Ona je mir sve do pojave zore“ – هِيَ je noć Kadr.
why.en: “(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn” – هِيَ is the Night of Decree.

why.bs: „Džehennem će, uistinu, biti prebivalište“ – فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ: هِيَ ponavlja ٱلْجَحِيمَ.
why.en: “Lo! hell will be his home” – فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ: هِيَ takes up ٱلْجَحِيمَ again.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za blizinu, ženski rod jednine (هَا + ذِهِ). Koristi se i za množinu stvari i životinja, koja se u arapskom slaže kao ženski rod jednine.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the near, feminine singular (هَا + ذِهِ). It is also used for a plural of things and animals, which in Arabic agrees as a feminine singular.

explanation.bs: Kao kod هَٰذَا: imenica s članom iza nje obično opisuje ono na što se pokazuje, a imenica bez člana je predikat; ali i određena imenica s odnosnom rečenicom može biti predikat (52:14).
explanation.en: As with هَٰذَا: a noun with the article after it usually names what is pointed at, a noun without it is the predicate; but a definite noun with a relative clause can also be the predicate (52:14).

why.bs: „Ovo je Vatra koju ste poricali“ – هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى.
why.en: “This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny” – هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى.

why.bs: „Reče: Ovo je kamila…“ – هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ: imenica bez člana, predikat.
why.en: “He said: (Behold) this [is a] she-camel…” – هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ: a noun without the article, the predicate.

why.bs: „…a ne približujte se ovom drvetu…“ – هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ: هَٰذِهِ je na mjestu akuzativa (objekat), ٱلشَّجَرَةَ u akuzativu.
why.en: “…but come not nigh this tree…” – هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ: هَٰذِهِ is in the place of the accusative (the object), ٱلشَّجَرَةَ accusative.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za blizinu, množina za oba roda (هَا + أُولَاءِ). Ne mijenja se: u svakom padežu završava na -i.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the near, plural for both genders (هَا + أُولَاءِ). It does not change: in every case it ends in -i.

explanation.bs: Isti oblik kao subjekat i iza prijedloga ili riječi u genitivu.
explanation.en: The same form as a subject and after a preposition or a word in the genitive.

why.bs: „Reče: Ovo su moje kćeri…“ – هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ kao subjekat.
why.en: “He said: Here are my daughters…” – هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ as the subject.

grammar.bs: Pokazna zamjenica za daljinu, ženski rod jednine: تِـ + lām udaljenosti + كَ obraćanja. Kao هَٰذِهِ, koristi se i za množinu stvari: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ – ‚to su ajeti‘.
grammar.en: The demonstrative of the far, feminine singular: تِـ + the lām of distance + the كَ of address. Like هَٰذِهِ, it is also used for a plural of things: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ – ‘those are the verses’.

explanation.bs: Na početku nekih sura upućuje na ajete Knjige (‚to su / ovo su‘); uz osobe i stvari ženskog roda znači ‚ta‘.
explanation.en: At the start of some surahs it points to the verses of the Book (‘those / these are’); with persons and things in the feminine it means ‘that’.

why.bs: „To su ajeti Knjige koja jasno kazuje“ – ءَايَٰتُ je množina, ali تِلْكَ je jednina ženskog roda.
why.en: “These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain” – ءَايَٰتُ is plural, but تِلْكَ is feminine singular.

why.bs: „A šta je to u tvojoj desnoj ruci, o Musa?“ – تِلْكَ upućuje na štap (عَصًا, ženski rod).
why.en: “And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?” – تِلْكَ points to the staff (عَصًا, feminine).

why.bs: „To je zajednica koja je prošla…“ – تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ.
why.en: “Those are a people who have passed away…” – تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ.

grammar.bs: Samostalna zamjenica objekta: إِيَّا s nastavkom lica – إِيَّاكَ ‚tebe‘, إِيَّاهُ ‚njega‘, إِيَّايَ ‚mene‘, إِيَّاكُمْ ‚vas‘. Koristi se kad objekat ne može biti nastavak na glagolu: npr. kad je stavljen ispred glagola, povezan veznikom ili iza إِلَّا. Ibn Hišām kaže da je كَ u إِيَّاكَ čestica obraćanja bez mjesta u rečenici – ‚to je ispravno‘ – kao كَ u ذَٰلِكَ.
grammar.en: The detached object pronoun: إِيَّا with a person ending – إِيَّاكَ ‘you’, إِيَّاهُ ‘him’, إِيَّايَ ‘me’, إِيَّاكُمْ ‘you (pl.)’. It is used when the object cannot be a suffix on the verb: for example when it is put before the verb, joined by a conjunction, or after إِلَّا. Ibn Hišām says that the كَ in إِيَّاكَ is a particle of address with no place in the sentence – ‘that is the correct view’ – like the كَ in ذَٰلِكَ.

title.en: The object before the verb: ‘You alone…’

explanation.bs: Objekat stavljen ispred glagola se naglašava i ograničava: i Korkut i Sahih International to prenose kao ‚samo Tebi‘ / ‚It is You…‘, a Pickthall dodaje ‚(alone)‘.
explanation.en: An object put before the verb is stressed and restricted: both Korkut and Sahih International render it as ‘samo Tebi’ / ‘It is You…’, and Pickthall adds ‘(alone)’.

why.bs: „Samo Tebe obožavamo i samo od Tebe pomoć tražimo.“ – إِيَّاكَ ispred نَعْبُدُ.
why.en: “Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.” – إِيَّاكَ before نَعْبُدُ.

why.bs: „…i samo Mene se bojte!“ – وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ.
why.en: “…and fear [only] Me.” – وَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ.

title.en: An object joined by a conjunction

explanation.bs: Nastavak se ne može samostalno javiti iza veznika, pa se drugi objekat kaže s إِيَّا.
explanation.en: A suffix pronoun cannot stand alone after a conjunction, so a second object is said with إِيَّا.

why.bs: „…Mi ih opskrbljujemo, a i vas…“ – نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ: ‚ih‘ je nastavak, ‚vas‘ je إِيَّاكُمْ.
why.en: “…We shall provide for them and for you…” – نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ: ‘them’ is a suffix, ‘you’ is إِيَّاكُمْ.
